definitions.explanation: The day in spring when day and night are approximately equal in length, occurring around March 20-21 in the Northern Hemisphere. Also refers to the associated seasonal period in the traditional calendar.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Vernal Equinox Day is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the spring equinox, the days get longer.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of visiting family graves on the Vernal Equinox Day.

notes:
{春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ} (Vernal Equinox Day) is a Japanese national holiday, typically on March 20 or 21. It falls during ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ (spring equinox week), a Buddhist period for visiting family graves and honoring ancestors. Traditional foods include ぼた{餅|もち} (rice cakes coated in sweet bean paste).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}: Vernal Equinox Day (national holiday)
- {春分|しゅんぶん}{点|てん}: vernal equinox point (astronomy)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧: autumnal equinox
- ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧: equinox period (Buddhist observance)
- ⟦{夏至|げし}→夏至：19819_geshi⟧: summer solstice
- ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧: winter solstice
